articles.summary: Partnership gives Republic Bank parents powerful tools to teach money management skills to their children. Republic Bank (“Republic” or the “Bank”) has announced a new partnership with Greenlight, the award-winning money and safety app for families, giving Republic Bank checking account holders access to the Greenlight SELECT plan at no cost. Trusted by more than six million parents and kids nationwide, Greenlight helps families teach financial responsibility through real-world money management experiences. The Greenlight SELECT plan allows parents to assign chores, automate allowance payments, send money for everyday expenses, and monitor spending through customizable controls and real-time alerts. Along with a prepaid debit card designed for kids and teens, Greenlight helps young users build healthy financial habits through savings goals and its Level Up financial literacy program, which features educational games and challenges. articles.summary: Republic Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: RBCAA), parent company of Republic Bank Trust Company, announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.495 per share on Class A Common Stock and $0.45 per share on Class B Common Stock, payable January 15, 2027, to shareholders of record as of December 18, 2026. articles.summary: Republic Bank EarlyFunds™ allows clients to access money they've already earned before payday, with no loan and no credit check. Republic Bank (“Republic” or the “Bank”) has announced the launch of Republic Bank EarlyFunds™. This new digital banking offering gives clients access to a portion of their earned wages as soon as instantly.* Designed to provide greater flexibility and control over personal finances, Republic Bank EarlyFunds™ allows qualifying clients with direct deposit at Republic to access up to $1,000* in earned wages before their payday. Clients can receive funds instantly for a small fee or through a no-cost standard delivery option. Unlike traditional short-term borrowing options, Republic Bank EarlyFunds™ provides access to money clients have already earned. There are no credit checks, no interest charges, and no loans involved. As demand for flexible financial tools continues to grow, earned wage access has become increasingly popular among digital banking platforms
articles.title: Republic Bank Expands Financial Wellness Offerings with New Earned Wage Access Solution
